verification.scope: Navigation-only changes after complete reading of the 792-line input and 944-line final owner. Added 31 subject links per locale and four descriptive figure aliases. All prose, derivations, code, textual traces, captions, four scientific images, source-unit IDs and legacy anchors retained. No translation or release.

explanationReview.preserved: Assignment identities, variable split counts and reverse exchange; expert/input/gate/selected-softmax gradients; fixed-top-k boundaries and top-1 caveat; independent expert/rank imbalance; capacity/drop/padding/dropless/GroupedGEMM; FSDP weight traffic; TP/EP composition; explicit 1024-rank groups and per-physical-rank EP/TP byte ledger; EDP loss normalization; Parallel Folding; pinned DeepSeek-V3 and Llama 3 report cases.
explanationReview.sourceComparison: The full input exactly matches the 2026-10-23 accepted edition. That audit and the complete 2026-10-13 audit were read. Their pinned EDLS pp.118–136, Playbook EP, Megatron dispatcher/DDP/Folding, CS336 and primary-report comparisons are reused only for byte-identical explanations. This is not a new full-course or Harvard transfer claim.

freshSource.section: Complete all_to_all_single contract and examples, including uneven splits, complex values and experimental warning (rendered lines5980–6075). No whole torch.distributed documentation read claimed.

explanationReview.workedExamples: Four-token top-2 dispatch and inverse, selected-logit derivatives -0.375/+0.375, [3,2,3,0] expert versus [5,3] rank loads, capacity [3,6,5,2] at C4, all 1024 coordinate partitions, 16384 assignment identities, EP1.75/TP14/31.5MiB outgoing ledger and 8× wrong-EDP negative control checked.
explanationReview.style: Full input and final text read with no-ai-slop/eval.md and repository technical qualifications. Existing supported explanations retained without compression or synthetic replacement.

numpy.scope: Dense versus routed nonlinear experts at TP1/2/3; permutation negative, owner relabeling, finite differences for x/W1/W2/router, capacity and load, 1024 virtual-rank partitions, exact 16384-assignment traffic ledger, SUM/AVG EDP normalization.
